name: Osteoclast-lineage development driven by M-CSF
rationale: Members cover macrophage/osteoclast proliferation, fusion and differentiation, bone resorption and CSF1/interleukin receptor signaling; unlike C1/C2/C4 the theme carries osteoclast and bone-resorption terms plus M-CSF signaling, and unlike C3/C4 it lacks monocyte/dendritic differentiation.

name: Platelet activation via G protein-coupled agonist receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation or coagulation; the theme uniquely has thrombin PAR, thromboxane TP, ADP P2Y1/P2Y12 and prostacyclin receptor signaling, which C1/C2 (collagen/GP1b adhesion) and C3/C4 (integrin/Rap1) lack.

name: Planar cell polarity in convergent extension
rationale: Members are PCP establishment and PCP-Wnt signaling plus convergent extension in gastrulation, axis elongation, organogenesis and neural plate morphogenesis; C1/C2 are axial mesoderm/neural plate patterning and C3/C4 lack the convergent extension terms.

name: Gi/z-mediated adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenoceptors
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of cAMP by inhibitory G alpha (Gi/Gz) via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors; C1/C2 centre on catecholamine/insulin secretion, C3 on cAMP-PKA activation and C4 on muscarinic/adenosine/serotonin receptors.

core: Regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
name: NK and T cell cytotoxicity regulated by NK receptors
rationale: Members regulate NK and T cell cytotoxicity, degranulation and activation through NK surface receptors and lymphoid–non-lymphoid ligand interactions (incl. MHC class Ib); confusables instead carry granzyme killing, KIR cluster, tolerance or T cell proliferation.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members shape the embryonic face, palate, nose, cranium, limbs and digits from mesenchyme; C1/C3/C4 add pharyngeal organs (thymus, thyroid, ear) and C2 adds ossification/cartilage, while the theme uniquely has limbs and digits.

name: Fibroblast cell–matrix adhesion assembly
rationale: Members cover focal adhesion assembly, integrin production, fibronectin matrix formation, SRF cytoskeletal remodeling and fibroblast migration; confusables emphasise integrin/syndecan surface interactions, stress fibres or EMT/YAP stromal programs.

core: Negative regulation of skeletal muscle growth
name: Negative regulation of skeletal muscle growth
rationale: Members restrain myoblast/myotube differentiation and muscle development, maintain satellite cells and drive disuse atrophy; C2 is positive myogenesis and C1/C4 carry muscle activity, hypertrophy and growth.

name: Recombinational telomere maintenance via break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere recombination, D-loop/t-circle handling, capping and replication with mitotic checkpoint/division; break-induced replication and DNA unwinding set it apart from C3, and the confusables carry broader repair and fork terms.

name: cAMP synthesis driving PKA activation
rationale: Members cover GPCR/forskolin-stimulated cAMP production and PKA activation; C1 is adenylate cyclase inhibition and C2–C4 extend to CREB phosphorylation and neuronal cyclases.

core: Vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
name: COPI vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi
rationale: Members are vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, ER exit sites and COPI budding/retrograde traffic; C3/C4 are COPII anterograde transport and C1 lacks COPI terms.

name: Kidney development with nephron tubule differentiation
rationale: Members span intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud and metanephric nephron formation; the theme uniquely carries nephron segment terms (distal tubule, loop of Henle, S-/comma-shaped bodies) that the ureteric-bud-induction confusables lack.

core: Endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane
name: Endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members regulate endosome-to-plasma-membrane and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane delivery, receptor recycling and endosome organization; C3 is Golgi/endosome retrograde traffic and C4 is membrane tubulation.

core: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor differentiation
name: Transcriptional restraint of myeloid progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members are progenitor transcription programs (RUNX1, VENTX, granulopoiesis, promyelocyte module) and negative regulation of monocyte, macrophage and granulocyte differentiation; confusables carry positive differentiation and mature monocyte/neutrophil terms.

name: RAF–MEK–ERK cascade and its feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAF/MEK/ERK activation by wild-type and oncogenic RAS/RAF/MAPK variants and ERK negative feedback/dephosphorylation; all confusables carry upstream RAS regulation (SOS, GAPs, RIT) the theme lacks.

name: Vitamin K and C cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation, ascorbate metabolism/transport and vitamin E/C responses; C1 lacks the vitamin C terms, C2 lacks vitamin K, and C3/C4 centre on vitamin D or ubiquinone.

name: Dendritic cell chemokine production via cGAS–STING
rationale: Members cover dendritic cell cytokine and CCL5 production with cGAS–STING activation and cGAMP import; C1/C2 lack the STING terms and C3/C4 lack the dendritic-cell chemokine terms.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members cover rRNA, tRNA, snRNA and cap methylation with snoRNP/snRNP assembly and transport; snRNP assembly, snRNA transport and cap hypermethylation distinguish it from all confusables, which add pseudouridylation or diphthamide.

core: Control of mRNA stability and translation
name: Stress granule control of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members regulate mRNA stabilization, localization and translation together with stress granule dynamics, PKR and arsenite stress; C2 lacks the stress granule terms and C1/C3/C4 add ARE-mediated decay factors.

name: Chondrocyte development in embryonic cartilage and joints
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and joint morphogenesis; joint terms separate it from C1/C3 (ossification, tendon) and cartilage morphogenesis from C2/C4 (articular homeostasis).

name: Beta-cell insulin secretion via K-ATP channel coupling
rationale: Members cover regulation of pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion by glucose, incretins, fatty acids and neurotransmitters; K-ATP channel terms distinguish it from C4, and confusables C1–C3 centre on GLUT4 translocation and insulin action.

name: Ubiquitin–proteasome degradation with deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin chain formation of many linkages, deubiquitinase families, proteasome assembly and degradation; C1/C3 add ERAD/autophagy quality control and C2/C4 add neddylation/COP9.

name: Rab-regulated Golgi organization and COPI traffic
rationale: Members cover Golgi structure, COPI anterograde/retrograde traffic, vesicle tethering and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation incl. geranylgeranylation; confusables add TGN-lysosome and endosome-Golgi transport and lack the Rab GEF/prenylation terms.

name: Amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are general L-/alpha-amino acid and glutamine-family metabolism plus proline synthesis and catabolism; confusables centre on glycine, serine and glyoxylate metabolism.

name: Retinoid metabolism including inherited retinoid disorders
rationale: Members cover vitamin A/retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism and transport; the retinoid disease and STRA6 defect terms distinguish it from C1–C3, and RA biosynthesis from the visual-cycle confusable C4.

name: Telomere capping blocking end joining and recombination
rationale: Members cover telomere capping, packaging, protein recruitment and protection from NHEJ and recombination; C1/C2/C4 carry telomere replication (C-strand, D-loop, t-circle) and C3 telomerase/Cajal body terms.

name: Energy-carrier metabolism of nucleotides and phosphocreatine
rationale: Members cover nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange, phosphocreatine and NAD/NADP metabolism; C1/C2 lack NAD terms, C3 lacks interconversion and C4 lacks creatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport.

name: Telomere maintenance with telomerase Cajal body trafficking
rationale: Members span telomerase extension, C-strand synthesis, recombination-based maintenance, capping and senescence; Cajal body/telomerase RNA terms distinguish it from DNA-repair confusables C1/C2, and telomere-specific terms from C3/C4.

name: Inflammatory cytokine control by TLR2/4 and NLRP inflammasomes
rationale: Members regulate IL-1/IL-6/TNF production via bacterial-lipid sensing by TLR2/4 and NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes; C2 is caspase-4/5 pyroptosis, and C1/C3/C4 lack the inflammasome and LPS-detection terms.

name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction complex stability
rationale: Members cover beta-catenin/TCF target activation and AXIN/APC destruction complex stability; AXIN stabilization/degradation terms separate it from C1, C2 and C4, which carry target repression and receptor-level events.
